notes.title: OLAGUNA CHRONICLES 命运启示录-阿尔巴雷克战纪- 1.11
notes.notes:
The update points are as follows

[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} / 36386320/7 e5e5235385102306bd3195b871a78a5d779fadb. PNG [/ img]



1. Fixed a problem with balomir's blunt gun configuration design, which cannot be removed manually after entering blunt gun configuration.



2. Modified the performance of punch weapon, now punch weapon can not counter. Weapon critical strike rate +45



3. Temporarily shut down the coordination system.



4. Fixed infinite experience gain caused by infinite reinforcement problem in chapter 12. Now up to 80 rounds of reinforcement.



5.12 the adinand faction reinforcements have been reduced from level 15 to level 10.



6. Fixed a bug in chapter 13 where death of the dead sent to the wilkie battle zone and could not leave.



7. Fixed a bug in chapter 14 where the main character was unable to learn the ability to chase down the enemy after the battle of basolick and son.



8. Changed 15 chapters of the sword - the life of the grixion BOSS, from 1200 to 1500.



9. Fixed an issue in chapter 15 where the main character was unable to obtain the sword - glaxion - after the battle.



10. The shop adds level 2 and level 3 repair materials, level 2 material is 8000/1. Level 3 material is 15000/1.



11. Adjust the usage limits on items such as movement rings, diligence rolls, etc.



12. Temporarily shuts down the master's sweep ability.



13. Recalibrate ability caps for all advanced classes.



14. Adjusted wands and canes to gain experience.



15. Adjusted mediya's exclusive weapon "blood charm" attribute:

Damage increased to 15

Increased durability to 70

Range increased to 1-6

After damage can be placed in storage



16. Fixed a BUG with mediya's magic growth cap.



17. Added baisolic's exclusive AOE ability, "blast through the air" to deal 25 physical damage to all enemies within 2 cells of the perimeter, CD7 turn. After using wind break, the state speed of "wind damage shadow" is +4. Lasts 7 rounds, with diminishing returns per round.
